metadata.extraction: Public HTML inline module data arrays Qh/Vh/Zh/Kh/Jh and original app merge logic Fh; raw row schema [word, UK phonetic, US phonetic, part of speech, Chinese meaning].
metadata.mergeRule: Per book, the original app prepends 20 detailed entries and removes matching spellings from its raw list before adding the remaining rows.
metadata.audioPlayback: The source app constructs Youdao dictvoice URLs on demand (type=1 UK, type=2 US) and falls back to browser speech synthesis; no audio files are embedded in the word data.

words.example: Without regular use, language proficiency can deteriorate over time.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果缺乏定期使用，语言能力会随着时间逐渐衰退。
words.mnemonic: de（向下）+ terior（更差）+ ate → 变得更差 → 恶化
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 17 · Test 2 阅读

words.example: Anxiety before major standardized tests is a prevalent issue among students.
words.exampleTranslation: 考试前的焦虑在学生中是一个普遍存在的问题。
words.mnemonic: pre（在前）+ val（强壮）+ ent → 力量领先的 → 盛行的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 16 · Test 4 阅读

words.example: Artificial intelligence has brought unprecedented opportunities to language learning.
words.exampleTranslation: 人工智能为语言学习带来了前所未有的机遇。
words.mnemonic: un（无）+ precedent（先例）+ ed → 没有先例的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 18 · Test 1 写作

words.meaning: 可持续的；能长期维持的
words.example: A sustainable study routine beats a short burst of intense cramming.
words.exampleTranslation: 可持续的学习节奏胜过短期的突击式死记硬背。
words.mnemonic: sus（在下）+ tain（握住）+ able → 能托住的 → 可持续的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 15 · Test 3 阅读

words.example: Taking short breaks can mitigate mental fatigue during long study sessions.
words.exampleTranslation: 短暂休息可以缓解长时间学习带来的精神疲劳。
words.mnemonic: mit（送、放）+ ig（走）+ ate → 让问题走开 → 减轻
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 17 · Test 4 写作

words.example: Innovative teaching methods keep students engaged for longer periods.
words.exampleTranslation: 创新的教学方法能让学生保持更长时间的专注。
words.mnemonic: in（进入）+ nov（新）+ ative → 引入新事物的 → 创新的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 16 · Test 2 写作

words.example: The examination will commence at nine o'clock sharp.

words.mnemonic: com（共同）+ mens（开始）→ 一起开始
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 14 · Test 1 听力

words.meaning: 引人注目的；有说服力的；令人信服的

words.mnemonic: com（一起）+ pel（推）+ ling → 推动你相信的 → 有说服力的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 18 · Test 3 写作

words.example: Excessive screen time before bed is detrimental to both sleep and memory.
words.exampleTranslation: 睡前过长的屏幕时间对睡眠和记忆都有害。
words.mnemonic: detri（磨损）+ ment + al → 造成磨损的 → 有害的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 15 · Test 4 阅读

words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+ found（基础）→ 基础向深处延伸 → 深刻的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 17 · Test 1 写作

words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 16 · Test 3 听力

words.mnemonic: al（朝向）+ levi（轻）+ ate → 使变轻 → 减轻
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 17 · Test 2 写作

words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 16 · Test 1 阅读

words.exampleTranslation: 精通英语能带来报酬丰厚的职业机会。
words.mnemonic: lucr（利润）+ ative → 有利润的
words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 17 · Test 3 阅读

words.meaning: 微不足道的；可以忽略的

words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 18 · Test 4 阅读

words.examSource: 剑桥雅思 16 · Test 4 阅读
